marketing_description: The NUVO® Cloud Fixture (part 62-1850) provides 25 W of power draw at 120 V, 0.208 A, 60 Hz, delivering 1,100 lm of light at 3,000 K with a CRI of 90+ from a single 75 W LED bulb. Housed in a white‑finished steel housing with a white PMMA lens, the round 11‑inch flush‑mount fixture is dimmable, includes the LED bulb, and meets UL and ETL certification requirements. Its rated life of 50,000 hours supports long‑term operation in commercial settings.
